attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of defects, damage, deterioration, or performance issues observed during the assessment.

attributes.name: environmental_conditions
attributes.description: Environmental factors that may affect assessment results or asset condition (e.g., soil conditions, groundwater level, chemical exposure, temperature extremes).

attributes.name: estimated_repair_cost
attributes.description: Preliminary cost estimate for recommended repair or rehabilitation work, used for Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) and Operating Expenditure (OPEX) planning.

attributes.name: estimated_replacement_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost to fully replace the asset with equivalent new equipment or infrastructure.

attributes.name: failure_probability
attributes.description: Statistical probability (0.0000 to 1.0000) of asset failure within the next planning period, calculated from condition data, age, and historical failure rates.

attributes.name: inspection_equipment_used
attributes.description: Description of specialized equipment, instruments, or tools used during the assessment (e.g., CCTV crawler, ultrasonic thickness gauge, vibration analyzer, acoustic leak detector).

attributes.name: inspector_certification
attributes.description: Professional certifications held by the inspector relevant to the assessment method (e.g., NASSCO PACP/MACP/LACP for pipeline inspection, ASNT Level II for ultrasonic testing, thermography certification).

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Full name of the inspector or technician who conducted the assessment.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (decimal degrees) of the assessment location.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (decimal degrees) of the assessment location.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this condition assessment record was last updated.

attributes.name: next_assessment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next condition assessment based on asset criticality, condition grade, and inspection frequency requirements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional observations, comments, or contextual information recorded by the inspector during the assessment.

attributes.name: performance_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score (0-100 scale) representing the operational performance and efficiency of the asset relative to design specifications.

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: Recommended intervention strategy based on assessment findings: continue monitoring, schedule repair, plan rehabilitation, schedule replacement, no action required, or emergency repair needed.

attributes.name: recommended_action_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for the recommended intervention: immediate (0-30 days), urgent (1-6 months), high (6-12 months), medium (1-3 years), low (3+ years).

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assessment was performed to satisfy regulatory inspection requirements from Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), state primacy agencies, or other governing bodies.

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated number of years the asset can continue to operate before requiring major rehabilitation or replacement, based on current condition and deterioration rate.

attributes.name: reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when the assessment was reviewed and validated by a supervisor or subject matter expert.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Composite risk score calculated as the product of failure probability and consequence of failure, used to prioritize asset renewal and Capital Improvement Program (CIP) planning.

attributes.name: structural_integrity_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score (0-100 scale) representing the structural soundness of the asset based on inspection findings. Higher scores indicate better structural condition.

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Weather conditions at the time of assessment, relevant for outdoor inspections and certain testing methods.

products.name: criticality_rating
products.description: Stores the criticality evaluation for each asset, capturing consequence of failure (CoF) score, likelihood of failure (LoF) score, overall risk score, criticality tier (Critical/High/Medium/Low), redundancy availability, customer impact count, regulatory consequence flag, and the methodology version used. Criticality ratings drive maintenance prioritization, inspection frequency, and capital renewal sequencing per ISO 55001 and AWWA asset management best practices.
products.reference: ISO 55001 Risk Assessment / AWWA Criticality Assessment

attributes.name: criticality_rating_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the criticality rating record. Primary key for the criticality rating entity.

attributes.name: criticality_asset_registry_id

attributes.name: criticality_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical asset being evaluated for criticality. Links to the asset registry in IBM Maximo CMMS.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this criticality rating was formally approved for operational use. Supports audit trail and governance compliance.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role that approved this criticality rating for operational use. Supports governance and accountability for asset management decisions.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date when the criticality assessment was performed. Distinct from the effective date; tracks when the analysis was conducted.

attributes.name: assessment_performed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person, team, or system that performed the criticality assessment. Supports audit trail and accountability for rating decisions.

attributes.name: capital_renewal_priority_rank
attributes.description: Relative priority ranking for capital renewal or replacement within the asset portfolio. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Derived from criticality tier and overall risk score.

attributes.name: cip_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset is eligible for inclusion in the Capital Improvement Program based on its criticality rating and condition. True if eligible for CIP funding consideration.

attributes.name: consequence_of_failure_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score representing the business, operational, safety, environmental, and regulatory impact if the asset fails. Typically scaled 1-100 or 1-10 depending on methodology.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this criticality rating record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: criticality_tier
attributes.description: Categorical classification of asset criticality derived from the overall risk score. Determines maintenance frequency, inspection intervals, and capital renewal priority.

attributes.name: customer_impact_count
attributes.description: Estimated number of customers or service connections that would be affected by failure of this asset. Used to quantify consequence of failure for distribution and collection system assets.

attributes.name: environmental_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether failure of this asset would result in environmental harm such as discharge of untreated wastewater, contamination of water sources, or SSO/CSO events. True if environmental impact is likely.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial consequence of asset failure including emergency repair costs, lost revenue, regulatory fines, and liability claims. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_days
attributes.description: Recommended interval in days between routine inspections based on the criticality tier. Critical assets require more frequent inspection than low-criticality assets.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this criticality rating record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: likelihood_of_failure_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score representing the probability of asset failure based on age, condition, maintenance history, and operating environment. Typically scaled 1-100 or 1-10 depending on methodology.

attributes.name: methodology_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the criticality assessment methodology used to calculate this rating. Enables tracking of methodology changes over time and ensures consistent application across asset portfolio.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next criticality reassessment. Critical assets typically require more frequent review cycles than low-criticality assets.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special considerations, assumptions, or qualitative factors that influenced the criticality rating. Supports transparency and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: overall_risk_score
attributes.description: Composite risk score calculated from Consequence of Failure and Likelihood of Failure scores. Typically computed as CoF × LoF. Used to rank assets for maintenance and capital investment prioritization.

attributes.name: preventive_maintenance_frequency_days
attributes.description: Recommended interval in days between preventive maintenance activities based on the criticality tier. Critical assets require more frequent PM than low-criticality assets.

attributes.name: public_health_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether failure of this asset would pose a direct threat to public health through loss of water supply, water quality degradation, or exposure to contaminants. True if public health risk exists.

attributes.name: rating_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this criticality rating becomes effective and is used for maintenance prioritization and capital planning decisions.

attributes.name: rating_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when this criticality rating expires and must be reassessed. Nullable for ratings without a defined review cycle.

attributes.name: rating_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the criticality rating record. Active ratings are used for operational decisions; superseded ratings are retained for historical analysis.

attributes.name: redundancy_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether backup or redundant assets are available to maintain service if this asset fails. True if redundancy exists, False if asset is a single point of failure.

attributes.name: regulatory_consequence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether failure of this asset would result in regulatory non-compliance, permit violations, or mandatory reporting under SDWA, CWA, or NPDES. True if regulatory consequences exist.

attributes.name: review_frequency_months
attributes.description: Standard interval in months between criticality reassessments for this asset. Typically shorter for critical assets and longer for low-criticality assets.

attributes.name: safety_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether failure of this asset would create safety hazards for employees, contractors, or the public (e.g., chemical release, electrical hazard, structural collapse). True if safety risk exists.

attributes.name: service_disruption_duration_hours
attributes.description: Estimated duration in hours that service would be disrupted if this asset fails, accounting for repair time, parts availability, and system restoration procedures.

products.name: work_order
products.description: Core transactional record for all maintenance activities — preventive (PM), corrective (CM), predictive (PdM), and emergency work orders. Captures work type, priority, originating asset, assigned crew/technician, scheduled and actual start/finish dates, labor hours, failure code, cause code, remedy code, downtime duration, and work order cost. Includes material line items: parts consumed or reserved with quantity, unit cost, issue date, storeroom, and reservation status. Enables actual vs. planned cost tracking (labor, material, contractor/service, overhead) per work order with GL account code and cost center. The authoritative SSOT for maintenance execution and O&M cost accounting, synchronized with IBM Maximo Work Order and SAP PM Order. Supports rate case cost justification and AWWA benchmarking.
products.reference: IBM Maximo Work Order / SAP PM Maintenance Order

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Notes on regulatory requirements, permits, or compliance documentation that must be completed as part of this job plan (e.g., EPA reporting, NPDES permit conditions).

attributes.name: required_labor_crafts
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of labor craft skills required to execute this job plan (e.g., 'Electrician, Mechanic, Instrumentation Technician').

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking changes to the job plan over time. Incremented each time the job plan is updated and re-approved.

attributes.name: safety_requirements
attributes.description: Detailed safety procedures and precautions required for this job plan, including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), confined space entry, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), and hazard mitigation steps.

attributes.name: source_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the source document or standard from which this job plan was derived (e.g., 'AWWA M11 Steel Pipe Manual', 'Manufacturer Service Bulletin 2023-04').

attributes.name: task_sequence
attributes.description: Step-by-step instructions detailing the ordered sequence of tasks to be performed. Each step includes action description, safety notes, and quality checkpoints.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title of the job plan that summarizes the maintenance activity (e.g., 'Pump Impeller Replacement', 'Chlorine Analyzer Calibration').

attributes.name: tools_list
attributes.description: List of specialized tools, equipment, and instruments required to perform this job plan (e.g., 'Torque wrench, multimeter, pipe wrench set').

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person who originally created this job plan record.

Supports reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) analysis, MTBF/MTTR calculations, and regulatory SSO/CSO incident reporting. Linked to corrective work orders in IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: work_order_id

attributes.name: actual_repair_cost
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Repair Cost in US Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Actual total cost incurred to repair or replace the failed asset after work completion.

tag_set.value: Actual Repair Cost in US Dollars (USD)

attributes.name: affected_system
attributes.description: The operational system or process affected by the failure (e.g., high service pump station, chlorination system, SCADA network, distribution main).

attributes.name: corrective_actions_recommended
attributes.description: List of recommended corrective and preventive actions to prevent recurrence of similar failures.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this failure record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cso_event_flag

attributes.name: customers_affected_count

attributes.name: detection_method

attributes.name: downtime_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration in hours that the asset was out of service due to the failure.

attributes.name: emergency_response_actions
attributes.description: Detailed description of immediate emergency response actions taken to mitigate the failure (e.g., valve isolation, backup system activation, customer notification).

attributes.name: environmental_impact_description
attributes.description: Description of any environmental impact resulting from the failure (e.g., water body contamination, soil contamination, habitat damage).

attributes.name: failure_cause
attributes.description: Identified root cause of the failure (e.g., age-related deterioration, improper installation, inadequate maintenance, design deficiency, operational error, external damage).

attributes.name: failure_criticality_score
attributes.description: Calculated criticality score based on failure severity, service impact, and asset importance (typically 1-100 scale).

attributes.name: failure_date
attributes.description: Calendar date when the asset failure occurred.

attributes.name: failure_effect

attributes.name: failure_mode

attributes.name: failure_number

attributes.name: failure_severity

attributes.name: failure_status

attributes.name: failure_time

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: mtbf_impact_flag

attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this failure event should be included in MTBF reliability calculations for the asset class.

attributes.description: Measured time in hours from failure detection to restoration of asset to full operational status.

tag_set.value: Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) in Hours

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes, observations, or context related to the failure event.

attributes.name: overflow_volume_gallons
attributes.description: Estimated volume of wastewater overflow in gallons resulting from SSO or CSO event, if applicable.

attributes.name: pressure_drop_psi

attributes.description: Measured drop in system pressure (PSI) resulting from the failure event.

tag_set.value: System Pressure Drop in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)

attributes.name: production_loss_mgd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Loss in Million Gallons per Day (MGD)
attributes.description: Estimated water production capacity lost due to the failure, measured in Million Gallons per Day.

tag_set.value: Production Loss in Million Gallons per Day (MGD)

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory agencies were notified of the failure event, if applicable.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the failure event requires notification to regulatory agencies (EPA, state primacy agency).

attributes.name: repair_cost_estimate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Repair Cost in US Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Estimated total cost to repair or replace the failed asset, including labor, materials, and contractor costs.

tag_set.value: Estimated Repair Cost in US Dollars (USD)

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the failure was fully resolved and the asset was restored to normal operation.

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_completed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a formal root cause analysis (RCA) has been completed for this failure event.

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_findings
attributes.description: Detailed findings and conclusions from the root cause analysis investigation, including contributing factors and systemic issues identified.

attributes.name: service_interruption_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the failure resulted in a complete service interruption to customers.

attributes.name: sso_event_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the failure resulted in a Sanitary Sewer Overflow event requiring regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: warranty_claim_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the failure is covered under manufacturer or contractor warranty and a claim was filed.

products.name: asset_meter
products.description: Tracks operational meters, counters, and their reading history for asset condition and usage monitoring — distinct from customer billing meters (owned by the metering domain). Examples include pump run-hours, motor starts, valve cycle counts, flow totalizers (MGD), pressure transducers (PSI), and vibration sensors. Captures meter type, unit of measure, current reading, rollover value, calibration status, and historical reading records (reading date/time, value, source — manual or SCADA/PI Historian automated, inspector ID, delta from previous reading). Feeds meter-based PM triggers, tracks asset utilization trends, and supports predictive maintenance analytics. Integrates with OSIsoft PI Historian. [SSOT: governed by metering.metering_meter] [DEPRECATED: Single source of truth is metering.metering_meter]
products.reference: IBM Maximo Asset Meter / OSIsoft PI Tag

attributes.name: asset_meter_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the asset meter record in the enterprise data platform. Primary key for the asset_meter product. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent physical asset (pump, motor, valve, pipe segment, vehicle, etc.) to which this operational meter or counter is attached. Links to the asset master record in the asset domain.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the functional location or facility location record where the metered asset is installed. Links to the location hierarchy in the asset domain (e.g., WTP, pump station, WWTP). Supports geographic and facility-level aggregation of meter data.

attributes.name: primary_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent physical asset (pump, motor, valve, pipe segment, vehicle, etc.) to which this operational meter or counter is attached. Links to the asset master record in the asset domain.

attributes.name: alarm_high_threshold
attributes.description: The upper alarm threshold value for this meter. When the reading exceeds this value, a SCADA or CMMS alarm is triggered. For example, high vibration alarm at 0.5 in/s for a pump motor. Supports integration with SCADA HMI alarm management.

attributes.name: alarm_low_threshold
attributes.description: The lower alarm threshold value for this meter. When the reading falls below this value, a SCADA or CMMS alarm is triggered. For example, low flow alarm at 0.1 MGD for a treatment process feed pump.

attributes.name: asset_metering_meter_id
attributes.description: The native meter identifier from IBM Maximo Asset Management CMMS (METERNAME or internal Maximo meter key). Used for system-of-record traceability and bidirectional synchronization between the Silver Layer and Maximo.

attributes.name: average_reading_rate
attributes.description: The average rate of change per day for this meter, calculated and stored by the CMMS during reading entry (not a derived KPI — stored as a CMMS field used for PM trigger forecasting). For example, average run-hours per day for a pump. Used by meter-based PM triggers to forecast next maintenance due date.

attributes.name: avg_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used by the CMMS to compute the average_reading_rate. SLIDING_WINDOW: rolling average over a configurable number of recent readings. FIXED_PERIOD: average over a fixed calendar period. LAST_READING: uses only the most recent reading interval.

attributes.name: calibration_interval_days
attributes.description: The required frequency of calibration expressed in calendar days. Used to compute next_calibration_date from last_calibration_date and to schedule calibration work orders in IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: calibration_status
attributes.description: Current calibration status of the meter instrument. CALIBRATED: within valid calibration period. DUE: calibration due within the next calibration_interval_days. OVERDUE: calibration date has passed without recalibration. IN_PROGRESS: currently being calibrated. NOT_REQUIRED: meter type does not require formal calibration (e.g., simple cycle counters).

attributes.name: calibration_tolerance
attributes.description: Acceptable measurement tolerance or accuracy specification for this meter expressed in the meter's unit of measure. Readings outside this tolerance trigger recalibration. For example, ±0.5 PSI for a pressure transducer or ±0.01 MGD for a flow totalizer.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset meter record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: current_reading
attributes.description: The most recent recorded value of the meter or counter as of the last_reading_date. For CONTINUOUS meters this is the cumulative total; for GAUGE meters this is the last observed point-in-time value. Principal quantitative fact for this MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the meter was permanently removed from service and retired. Null for active meters. Used for lifecycle reporting and asset history.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the meter was physically installed on the asset. Used to calculate meter age, warranty expiry, and to establish the baseline reading at installation.

attributes.name: is_regulatory_meter
attributes.description: Indicates whether readings from this meter are used in regulatory compliance reporting (e.g., EPA NPDES Discharge Monitoring Reports, Safe Drinking Water Act compliance, Monthly Operating Reports). True = regulatory-grade meter subject to calibration and data integrity requirements.

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the meter was most recently calibrated and certified as accurate. Critical for regulatory compliance where metered values (e.g., flow, pressure, chemical dosing) are used in EPA/NPDES reporting.

attributes.name: last_reading_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Meter Reading Date and Time
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent meter reading captured, whether from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian automated feed or manual entry in IBM Maximo. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

tag_set.value: Last Meter Reading Date and Time

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the physical location where the meter is installed on the asset, e.g., 'Discharge side of Pump 3 at WTP Building A', 'Inlet valve actuator shaft'. Supplements the parent asset location for field technician navigation.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer of the meter instrument or sensor hardware, e.g., Endress+Hauser, Yokogawa, Emerson, Siemens. Used for procurement, warranty tracking, and spare parts management.

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Engineering unit of measure for the meter reading, e.g., HOURS (run-hours), STARTS (motor starts), CYCLES (valve cycles), MGD (Million Gallons per Day), GPM (Gallons per Minute), PSI (Pounds per Square Inch), NTU (Nephelometric Turbidity Units), RPM, DEGREES_F, INCHES. Aligns with OSIsoft PI Historian tag engineering units.

attributes.name: meter_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the meter or counter, e.g., 'Pump 3 Run Hours', 'Valve 12 Cycle Count', 'Influent Flow Totalizer'. Used for display in CMMS work orders and PM triggers.

attributes.name: meter_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier for the meter as assigned in IBM Maximo CMMS or SAP PM. Used for cross-system reference and field identification. Distinct from customer billing meter numbers managed by the Metering domain.

attributes.name: meter_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the meter. ACTIVE: in service and collecting readings. INACTIVE: temporarily not in use. RETIRED: permanently decommissioned. SUSPENDED: readings paused (e.g., asset out of service). PENDING_CALIBRATION: due for or undergoing calibration.

attributes.name: meter_type
attributes.description: Classification of the meter per IBM Maximo meter type taxonomy. CONTINUOUS: accumulating counter that never resets (e.g., run-hours, cycle counts, flow totalizer). GAUGE: point-in-time measurement that can go up or down (e.g., PSI, vibration amplitude, temperature). CHARACTERISTIC: qualitative or categorical observation (e.g., condition rating, oil color).

attributes.name: metering_meter_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reference to single source of truth in metering.metering_meter
attributes.description: Foreign key to the canonical metering_meter record in metering domain

tag_set.value: Reference to single source of truth in metering.metering_meter

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model or part number for the meter instrument. Used for procurement, spare parts identification, and technical documentation lookup.

attributes.name: next_calibration_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which the meter must next be calibrated to maintain measurement accuracy and regulatory compliance. Drives calibration work order generation in IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI Historian tag identifier associated with this meter for automated SCADA data ingestion. Enables direct linkage between the CMMS meter record and the PI Historian time-series data stream. Null if the meter is not integrated with PI Historian.

attributes.name: pm_trigger_interval
attributes.description: The recurring interval of meter units between successive PM work order generations. For example, every 500 run-hours or every 1000 valve cycles. Works in conjunction with pm_trigger_threshold for ongoing PM scheduling.

attributes.name: pm_trigger_threshold
attributes.description: The meter reading value at which a Preventive Maintenance (PM) work order is automatically generated. For example, a pump PM triggered every 2000 run-hours. Core field enabling meter-based PM scheduling in IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: previous_reading
attributes.description: The meter reading value recorded immediately prior to the current reading. Used to calculate consumption delta between readings and to detect anomalous jumps or rollover events.

attributes.name: previous_reading_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Previous Meter Reading Date and Time
attributes.description: Timestamp of the meter reading that preceded the current reading. Used in conjunction with previous_reading to compute usage rate and validate reading intervals.

tag_set.value: Previous Meter Reading Date and Time

attributes.name: reading_frequency
attributes.description: Expected frequency at which meter readings are collected. CONTINUOUS: real-time SCADA/PI Historian streaming. HOURLY/DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY: scheduled batch collection. ON_DEMAND: readings taken only when required (e.g., during inspections or work orders).

attributes.name: reading_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum valid reading value for this meter as defined by the instrument's operating range or process design limits. Readings above this value are flagged as suspect or trigger alarms. For example, 150 PSI maximum for a distribution pressure transducer.

attributes.name: reading_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum valid reading value for this meter as defined by the instrument's operating range or process design limits. Readings below this value are flagged as suspect. For example, 0 PSI minimum for a pressure transducer.

attributes.name: reading_source
attributes.description: The system or method by which the current meter reading was captured. SCADA: from Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition system. PI_HISTORIAN: from OSIsoft PI Historian automated feed. MANUAL: entered manually by a technician in IBM Maximo. AMI: from Advanced Metering Infrastructure. CMMS_IMPORT: batch import from CMMS. FIELD_DEVICE: direct PLC/RTU feed.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_code
attributes.description: The regulatory parameter code or identifier associated with this meter for compliance reporting submissions, e.g., EPA DMR parameter code, NPDES permit parameter identifier, or state drinking water program monitoring code. Null if is_regulatory_meter is False.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, technician observations, or special instructions related to this meter. For example, notes about known reading anomalies, temporary bypass conditions, or pending replacement. Sourced from IBM Maximo meter remarks field.

attributes.name: rollover_value
attributes.description: The maximum value the meter counter can reach before rolling over to zero. Applicable to CONTINUOUS meters with fixed-digit displays (e.g., 99999.9 hours). Used to correctly compute cumulative usage across rollover events. Null if the meter has no rollover limit.

attributes.name: sap_measuring_point_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) Measuring Point ID
attributes.description: The measuring point identifier from SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) module corresponding to this asset meter. Enables reconciliation between IBM Maximo CMMS and SAP PM for assets managed across both systems.

tag_set.value: SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) Measuring Point ID

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's serial number uniquely identifying the physical meter instrument. Used for warranty claims, calibration certificates, and asset tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset meter record was most recently modified in the enterprise data platform. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: warranty
products.description: Tracks warranty coverage for assets and components, including warranty type (parts, labor, performance), vendor/manufacturer, warranty start and expiration dates, coverage terms, claim submission process, maximum claim value, and warranty status. Enables proactive warranty claim management before expiration and ensures maintenance work is routed through warranty channels when applicable, reducing OPEX.
products.reference: IBM Maximo Warranty / SAP PM Warranty

attributes.name: warranty_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each asset warranty record in the enterprise asset management system. Primary key for the asset_warranty data product.

attributes.name: construction_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.construction_contract. Business justification: Equipment warranties originate from construction contracts; warranty claim processing, vendor accountability, and performance bond claims require direct reference to the construction contract that spe

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Warranty record creation audit for procurement process tracking, warranty management program accountability, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or manufacturer who issued and is responsible for honoring this warranty. Used to route warranty claims to the correct counterparty.

attributes.name: warranty_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical infrastructure asset (e.g., pump, valve, pipe, electrical panel, vehicle, WTP/WWTP equipment) covered by this warranty record.

attributes.name: warranty_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical infrastructure asset (e.g., pump, valve, pipe, electrical panel, vehicle, WTP/WWTP equipment) covered by this warranty record.

attributes.name: claim_response_days
attributes.description: Contractually committed number of calendar days within which the vendor must respond to a submitted warranty claim. Used for SLA monitoring and vendor performance management.

attributes.name: claim_submission_process
attributes.description: Description of the required process for submitting a warranty claim, including required documentation, submission channel (e.g., vendor portal URL, email, phone), and any pre-authorization requirements. Ensures maintenance staff follow correct procedures.

attributes.name: claimed_amount_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative monetary value of all warranty claims submitted against this warranty record to date, expressed in USD. Used to track remaining claim capacity against the maximum claim value.

attributes.name: component_covered
attributes.description: Specific sub-component or assembly of the asset covered by this warranty record (e.g., 'motor winding', 'pump impeller', 'control panel', 'membrane module'). A single asset may have multiple warranty records covering different components.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: The vendor-issued or internally-assigned contract number governing the warranty terms and conditions. Used for legal reference and claim dispute resolution.

attributes.name: coverage_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which warranty coverage expires. Proactive monitoring of this date enables timely claim submission and maintenance routing through warranty channels before expiration, reducing OPEX.

attributes.name: coverage_scope
attributes.description: Narrative description of what is covered under this warranty, including specific components, failure modes, and exclusions. For example: 'Covers all mechanical and electrical components of the centrifugal pump excluding wear parts (seals, impellers) and damage caused by cavitation or improper operation.'

attributes.name: coverage_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which warranty coverage becomes effective. Typically aligned with the asset installation date, commissioning date, or purchase date depending on warranty terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this warranty record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code applicable to all monetary values on this warranty record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency environments for international equipment procurement.

attributes.name: duration_months
attributes.description: Total length of the warranty coverage period expressed in months. Derived from the vendor contract terms and used for planning and renewal tracking.

attributes.name: exclusions
attributes.description: Explicit list of conditions, components, or failure modes NOT covered by this warranty. Critical for maintenance routing decisions to avoid voiding coverage through excluded repair activities.

attributes.name: expiry_alert_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days before the coverage end date at which an automated alert should be triggered to notify asset managers and maintenance planners of impending warranty expiration. Enables proactive claim submission and maintenance routing.

attributes.name: extended_warranty_cost
attributes.description: The cost paid to purchase an extended warranty beyond the standard manufacturer warranty period, expressed in USD. Captured for CAPEX/OPEX planning and ROI analysis of extended warranty investments.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: The date the covered asset or component was physically installed and commissioned. Often used as the warranty coverage start trigger and is required for warranty claim substantiation.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this warranty record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: max_claim_value
attributes.description: The maximum cumulative monetary value of claims that can be submitted under this warranty agreement, expressed in USD. Enables OPEX planning and ensures claims do not exceed contractual limits.

attributes.name: maximo_warranty_code
attributes.description: The native warranty record identifier from IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS). Retained as a cross-reference key to enable bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational CMMS source system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional warranty-related information not captured in structured fields, such as special claim conditions, vendor negotiation history, or maintenance routing instructions specific to this warranty.

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_metric
attributes.description: For performance-type warranties, the specific operational metric that is guaranteed (e.g., 'pump flow rate >= 500 GPM', 'motor efficiency >= 92%', 'membrane rejection rate >= 99%'). Null for parts/labor-only warranties.

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum or target numeric value of the performance guarantee metric that the asset must achieve under the warranty. For example, 500 (GPM) or 92 (%). Used to trigger performance warranty claims when asset output falls below the guaranteed level.

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the performance guarantee threshold value (e.g., GPM, MGD, PSI, %, NTU). Ensures correct interpretation of the numeric threshold in the context of the guaranteed metric.

attributes.name: purchase_date
attributes.description: The date the asset or component was purchased. Some warranties are triggered from purchase date rather than installation date; retained for accurate coverage period calculation.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The SAP purchase order number associated with the original procurement of the asset or component. Links the warranty to the procurement transaction for audit and claim substantiation.

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: The date the warranty was formally registered with the vendor or manufacturer. Some warranties require registration within a specified period post-purchase to be valid; failure to register may void coverage.

attributes.name: renewal_option
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warranty agreement includes an option to renew or extend coverage beyond the original expiration date. If True, renewal terms and pricing should be captured in the coverage_scope field.

attributes.name: requires_oem_service
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warranty terms require that all maintenance and repair work be performed exclusively by the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) or an OEM-authorized service provider. If True, routing non-OEM technicians to this asset may void the warranty.

attributes.name: sap_pm_order_number
attributes.description: The SAP PM maintenance order number associated with warranty-covered repair or maintenance work. Links warranty coverage to the SAP PM work order for cost recovery and OPEX tracking.

attributes.name: transferable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this warranty can be transferred to a new owner or operator in the event of asset sale, transfer, or organizational restructuring. Relevant for capital project asset handovers.

attributes.name: vendor_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for the designated warranty claims contact at the vendor or manufacturer. Used for formal claim submission and written correspondence.

attributes.name: vendor_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the designated warranty claims contact person at the vendor or manufacturer organization. Used to initiate and follow up on warranty claims.

attributes.name: vendor_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for the designated warranty claims contact at the vendor or manufacturer. Used to initiate and follow up on warranty claims.

attributes.name: warranty_number
attributes.description: Externally-known warranty certificate or agreement number assigned by the vendor or manufacturer. Used for claim submission and correspondence with the warranty provider. Aligns with IBM Maximo warranty record identifier.

attributes.name: warranty_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the warranty record. 'active' indicates coverage is in force; 'expired' indicates the coverage period has ended; 'claimed' indicates a claim has been submitted and is under review; 'voided' indicates the warranty was invalidated (e.g., unauthorized repair); 'pending_activation' indicates the warranty has been registered but the coverage period has not yet started.

attributes.name: warranty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the warranty coverage scope. 'parts' covers replacement components only; 'labor' covers repair labor costs; 'performance' guarantees operational output levels (e.g., pump flow rate, motor efficiency); 'comprehensive' covers both parts and labor; 'extended' is a purchased extension beyond the original term; 'manufacturer' is the standard OEM warranty.

products.name: depreciation_schedule
products.description: Financial depreciation schedule for capital assets, capturing acquisition cost, salvage value, useful life (years), depreciation method (straight-line, declining balance, units of production), annual depreciation amount, accumulated depreciation, net book value, and depreciation start date. Aligned with GAAP/GASB standards for municipal utility accounting. Integrates with SAP FI/CO Fixed Asset module and supports CAPEX/OPEX reporting.
products.reference: SAP FI-AA Fixed Asset / GASB Statement 34

attributes.name: depreciation_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the depreciation schedule record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.cip_project. Business justification: Capitalized assets from CIP projects require depreciation schedules linked to originating project for GASB 34 compliance, rate case justification, and audit trail connecting capital expenditure author

attributes.name: depreciation_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital asset for which this depreciation schedule is maintained. Links to the enterprise asset registry.

attributes.name: depreciation_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital asset for which this depreciation schedule is maintained. Links to the enterprise asset registry.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Depreciation schedules calculate periodic depreciation expense for fixed assets. Direct link supports automated depreciation posting, GASB 34 infrastructure reporting, and rate base calculations for u

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation expense recognized from the depreciation start date through the end of the current fiscal period. Represents the contra-asset balance on the balance sheet. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total capitalized cost of the asset at acquisition, including purchase price, installation, freight, and any directly attributable costs required to bring the asset to its intended use. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: annual_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: The total depreciation expense allocated for the full fiscal year for this asset. For straight-line method: depreciable_base / useful_life_years. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA asset class code categorizing the type of capital asset for depreciation area assignment and useful life defaults (e.g., 'PUMP', 'PIPE', 'BLDG', 'VEHICLE', 'ELEC', 'METER').

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the capital asset being depreciated (e.g., 'WTP High-Service Pump Unit 3', 'WWTP Aeration Blower', '12-inch Ductile Iron Main - Oak Street').

attributes.name: asset_location_code
attributes.description: Functional location or facility code where the asset is installed (e.g., WTP facility code, WWTP unit, pump station ID, distribution zone). Aligns with IBM Maximo functional location hierarchy and Esri ArcGIS GIS asset registry.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: The externally-known fixed asset number as assigned in SAP FI/CO Fixed Asset Accounting (FI-AA) or IBM Maximo. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: capex_project_number
attributes.description: The Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project number associated with the asset's acquisition or construction. Links depreciation schedules to CAPEX planning and project close-out reporting.

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: The date the asset was formally capitalized and transferred from construction-in-progress (CIP) to fixed assets in SAP FI-AA. May differ from depreciation start date for assets with a commissioning lag.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP FI company code representing the legal entity or municipal utility enterprise to which this depreciation schedule belongs. Supports multi-entity financial reporting and GASB fund accounting.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center to which depreciation charges are posted, enabling OPEX/CAPEX allocation by operational unit (e.g., WTP operations, distribution, wastewater).

attributes.name: declining_balance_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied per period for declining balance or double declining balance depreciation methods. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2000 = 20%). Null for straight-line method.

attributes.name: depreciable_base
attributes.description: The amount subject to depreciation, calculated as acquisition cost minus salvage value. This is the total amount to be allocated over the asset's useful life. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: depreciation_area_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA depreciation area identifier representing the valuation purpose (e.g., '01' for book depreciation per GAAP/GASB, '15' for tax depreciation, '20' for cost accounting). Supports parallel valuation for regulatory and tax reporting.

attributes.name: depreciation_convention
attributes.description: The period convention applied to determine depreciation in the first and last year of the asset's life (e.g., full_month, half_year, pro_rata). Aligns with SAP FI-AA period control settings.

attributes.name: depreciation_end_date
attributes.description: The projected or actual date on which depreciation ceases, corresponding to the end of the asset's useful life or full depreciation of the depreciable base.

attributes.name: depreciation_key
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA depreciation key code that defines the calculation method, period control, and base value for depreciation posting (e.g., 'LINR' for straight-line, '0000' for no depreciation). Enables direct reconciliation with SAP Fixed Asset Accounting.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to allocate the depreciable base over the asset's useful life. Straight-line is most common for municipal water utility infrastructure per GASB. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: straight_line|declining_balance|double_declining_balance|units_of_production|sum_of_years_digits — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: depreciation_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which depreciation begins for the asset, typically the in-service date or acquisition date per GAAP/GASB capitalization policy.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: The date the asset was retired, disposed of, or decommissioned. Triggers cessation of depreciation and recognition of any gain or loss on disposal in SAP FI-AA.

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Cash or fair value received upon disposal or sale of the asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal: disposal_proceeds minus net_book_value at disposal date. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (month 1–12) within the fiscal year for which this depreciation record applies. Enables monthly depreciation posting and period-end close reconciliation in SAP FI/CO.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this depreciation schedule record applies. Supports annual depreciation posting, CAPEX/OPEX reporting, and GASB financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: Governmental fund code (e.g., Enterprise Fund, Capital Projects Fund) to which the asset and its depreciation are attributed, per GASB fund accounting requirements for municipal utilities.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP FI General Ledger account code for the depreciation expense posting (e.g., the depreciation expense account and accumulated depreciation contra-asset account). Enables financial statement mapping.

attributes.name: impairment_loss
attributes.description: Cumulative impairment charges recognized against the asset when its carrying value exceeds its recoverable amount, per GAAP ASC 360 impairment testing. Reduces net book value beyond scheduled depreciation. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: The date the asset was placed into operational service. This is the trigger date for depreciation commencement per GAAP/GASB policy and aligns with IBM Maximo asset activation.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date the depreciation schedule was last reviewed and validated by the asset accounting team, supporting annual audit requirements and GASB financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the asset on the balance sheet, calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. Key metric for CAPEX/OPEX planning and asset renewal decisions. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording significant accounting judgments, useful life revision rationale, impairment triggers, regulatory directives, or other material information relevant to this depreciation schedule.

attributes.name: period_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: The depreciation expense allocated for the specific fiscal period (month). Used for monthly journal entry posting to the depreciation expense account in SAP FI/CO. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this depreciation schedule record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this depreciation schedule record was last modified, supporting change tracking, audit trail, and period-end reconciliation.

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated remaining useful life of the asset in years as of the last assessment date. Used for condition-based depreciation adjustments and asset renewal planning under CIP.

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the asset accountant or finance officer who last reviewed and approved this depreciation schedule record, supporting audit trail and SOX/GASB compliance.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life, used to calculate the depreciable base. For most water utility infrastructure, this is often zero. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the depreciation schedule record. 'active' = depreciation ongoing; 'suspended' = temporarily halted (e.g., asset taken out of service); 'fully_depreciated' = net book value at or near salvage value; 'disposed' = asset retired; 'impaired' = impairment recognized; 'draft' = pending approval.

attributes.name: units_of_production_period
attributes.description: Actual production units consumed during the current fiscal period, used to calculate period depreciation under the units-of-production method (e.g., gallons pumped, operating hours logged via SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian).

attributes.name: units_of_production_total
attributes.description: Total estimated production units over the asset's useful life, used as the denominator for units-of-production depreciation method (e.g., total gallons pumped, total operating hours). Applicable only when depreciation_method = 'units_of_production'.

attributes.name: useful_life_revised_years
attributes.description: Updated estimated useful life in years following a formal engineering reassessment or condition assessment. Replaces original useful_life_years for prospective depreciation calculation.

attributes.name: useful_life_revision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset's estimated useful life was last revised, triggering a prospective change in depreciation calculation per GAAP ASC 250 change in accounting estimate.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated useful life of the asset in years, as determined by engineering assessment and aligned with AWWA asset life guidelines and GASB/GAAP standards (e.g., 50 years for water mains, 20 years for pumps, 10 years for meters).

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure element linking the asset to its originating Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project for CAPEX tracking and project settlement.

products.name: acquisition
products.description: Records the acquisition of new assets into the utility's asset base, capturing acquisition type (purchase, construction, donation, transfer), acquisition date, purchase order reference, vendor/contractor, acquisition cost, funding source (CAPEX, grant, developer contribution), commissioning date, and initial condition grade. Triggers creation of the asset_registry record and depreciation_schedule. Integrates with SAP MM purchase orders and SAP FI asset capitalization.
products.reference: SAP FI-AA Asset Acquisition / IBM Maximo Asset

attributes.name: acquisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset acquisition record. Primary key for the asset acquisition data product.

attributes.name: acquisition_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset being acquired in the asset registry. Links this acquisition to the corresponding asset_registry record.

attributes.name: acquisition_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset being acquired in the asset registry. Links this acquisition to the corresponding asset_registry record.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Capital Improvement Program project identifier if the asset was acquired as part of a capital project. Links to project management and budget tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Acquisitions are charged to departmental cost centers for capital budget tracking, CIP program management, and accountability. Supports budget-to-actual variance reporting for capital projects.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the Water Treatment Plant (WTP), Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP), pump station, or other facility where the asset is located.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Capital asset acquisitions post to specific GL accounts for capitalization, depreciation tracking, and GASB 34 infrastructure reporting. Critical for financial statement preparation and regulatory com

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor in the procurement or Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset was legally acquired or title transferred to the utility. Used for depreciation start date calculation and asset lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: acquisition_status
attributes.description: Current status of the acquisition record in the workflow. Tracks progression from initiation through completion and asset registry creation.

attributes.name: acquisition_type
attributes.description: Method by which the asset was acquired into the utility's asset base. Determines accounting treatment and capitalization rules.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset acquisition was formally approved by the designated authority. Part of the audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the manager or authority who approved the asset acquisition. Required for audit trail and governance.

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: Detailed categorization within the asset class such as pump, valve, pipe, tank, or vehicle. Supports asset hierarchy and reporting.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the asset type such as treatment equipment, distribution infrastructure, collection system, or vehicle. Used for depreciation schedule assignment.

attributes.name: capitalization_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount threshold for capitalizing an asset as defined by the utility's accounting policy. Typically ranges from $1,000 to $5,000 for water utilities.

attributes.name: capitalization_threshold_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the acquisition cost meets the utility's capitalization threshold for fixed asset recording. Determines if asset is capitalized or expensed.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset was placed into service and became operational. Marks the start of depreciation for accounting purposes.

attributes.name: contractor_name
attributes.description: Name of the construction contractor who built or installed the asset, applicable for construction acquisition type.

attributes.name: cost
attributes.description: Total cost of acquiring the asset including purchase price, installation, freight, and other capitalizable costs. Basis for depreciation calculation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset acquisition record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the acquisition cost. Typically USD for United States water utilities.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to depreciate the asset over its useful life. Straight-line is most common for water utility infrastructure.

attributes.name: functional_location
attributes.description: SAP PM functional location code representing the hierarchical location of the asset within the utility's infrastructure. Supports Geographic Information System (GIS) integration.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Source of funds used to finance the asset acquisition. Critical for Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) tracking and regulatory rate case filings.

attributes.name: grant_award_num
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the grant award that funded the acquisition, required for grant compliance reporting.

attributes.name: grant_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the federal, state, or local grant program that funded the acquisition, if applicable. Examples include EPA Water Infrastructure Finance and Innovation Act (WIFIA) or State Revolving Fund (SRF).

attributes.name: initial_condition_grade
attributes.description: Condition assessment grade assigned at the time of acquisition. Baseline for future condition monitoring and asset health tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset acquisition record was last updated. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: maximo_asset_num
attributes.description: IBM Maximo Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) asset number assigned at acquisition. External system identifier for cross-reference.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special circumstances, conditions, or details about the asset acquisition. Supports audit trail and historical context.

attributes.name: purchase_order_num
attributes.description: Purchase order number from SAP Materials Management (MM) or procurement system authorizing the asset acquisition. Links to procurement transaction.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life. Used in depreciation calculation for certain methods.

attributes.name: sap_equipment_num
attributes.description: SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Plant Maintenance (PM) equipment number assigned at acquisition. External system identifier for cross-reference.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset in years for depreciation calculation. Varies by asset class per Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) guidelines.

attributes.name: warranty_duration_months
attributes.description: Duration of the warranty period in months. Calculated from warranty start and expiry dates for reporting purposes.

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manufacturer or contractor warranty period ends. Critical for maintenance planning and defect liability tracking.

attributes.name: warranty_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manufacturer or contractor warranty period begins for the acquired asset.

attributes.name: work_order_num
attributes.description: Work order number from IBM Maximo or SAP PM for construction or installation activities related to the acquisition.

products.name: disposal
products.description: Records the retirement, disposal, or decommissioning of assets from the utility's active inventory. Captures disposal date, disposal method (salvage, demolition, sale, transfer), disposal proceeds, reason for retirement (end of life, failure, regulatory, replacement), authorizing approver, and final book value at disposal. Triggers SAP FI-AA asset retirement posting and updates asset_registry operational status to Retired.
products.reference: SAP FI-AA Asset Retirement / IBM Maximo Asset Disposal

attributes.name: disposal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset disposal record. Primary key for the asset disposal transaction.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CIP project that triggered the asset replacement and disposal, if applicable. Links disposal to capital planning and renewal programs.

attributes.name: disposal_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset being disposed from the asset registry. Links to the physical infrastructure asset (pipe, pump, valve, equipment, vehicle) that is being retired or decommissioned.

attributes.name: disposal_replacement_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the new asset that replaced the disposed asset, if disposal reason was replacement. Links retired asset to its successor for lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Asset disposals generate gain/loss transactions posted to specific GL accounts for financial reporting. Required for accurate net book value adjustments and GASB compliance in financial statements.

attributes.name: primary_disposal_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset being disposed from the asset registry. Links to the physical infrastructure asset (pipe, pump, valve, equipment, vehicle) that is being retired or decommissioned.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or contractor who performed the disposal, demolition, or removal services. Links to vendor master data in SAP MM or procurement system.

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: The total depreciation expense accumulated on the asset from installation date through disposal date. Used in calculating book value and gain/loss on disposal.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the disposal transaction was formally approved by the authorizing approver. Required before disposal can proceed.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorizing approver who approved the asset disposal. Typically a senior manager, director, or capital planning committee member with authority over asset retirement decisions.

attributes.name: book_value_at_disposal
attributes.description: The net book value (original acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation) of the asset at the time of disposal. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal for financial reporting.

attributes.name: buyer_contact_info
attributes.description: Contact information (phone, email, or address) for the buyer of the asset. Used for transfer documentation and warranty transfer. Confidential business contact data.

attributes.name: buyer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or organization that purchased the asset, if disposal method was sale or auction. Null for other disposal methods.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the physical disposal activity was completed. May differ from disposal effective date if removal or demolition took multiple days.

attributes.name: cost
attributes.description: The total cost incurred to dispose of the asset. Includes demolition costs, removal costs, environmental remediation, transportation, and disposal fees.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center responsible for the asset at the time of disposal. Used for departmental cost allocation and budget tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this disposal record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this disposal record. Typically USD for U.S. water utilities.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the asset was officially retired or disposed. This is the principal business event date that triggers SAP FI-AA asset retirement posting and updates the asset registry operational status to Retired.

attributes.name: disposal_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the disposal transaction. Externally-known unique number used for tracking and audit purposes across SAP FI-AA and Maximo.

attributes.name: disposal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the disposal transaction. Tracks workflow from initiation through final completion and posting to financial systems. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|in_progress|completed|cancelled|reversed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: environmental_clearance_date
attributes.description: The date on which environmental clearance was obtained, if required. Null if no clearance was required.

attributes.name: environmental_clearance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting environmental clearance process, remediation actions taken, or hazardous material handling procedures followed during disposal.

attributes.name: environmental_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether environmental clearance or remediation was required before disposal. True for assets containing hazardous materials, lead pipes, asbestos insulation, or contaminated equipment.

attributes.name: gain_loss_on_disposal
attributes.description: The accounting gain or loss recognized on the disposal transaction, calculated as net disposal value minus book value at disposal. Positive values represent gains, negative values represent losses.

attributes.name: initiated_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the employee or department that initiated the disposal request. Typically an asset manager, operations supervisor, or maintenance planner.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or name of the person who last modified this disposal record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this disposal record was last updated. Audit trail for record modification.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: The physical location or facility where the asset was disposed, demolished, or removed from. May be a treatment plant, pump station, or field location.

attributes.name: maximo_disposal_code
attributes.description: The disposal transaction identifier in IBM Maximo CMMS. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail between Maximo and SAP FI-AA.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: The method by which the asset was disposed. Indicates whether the asset was sold, scrapped, transferred to another entity, donated, demolished, or salvaged for parts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salvage|demolition|sale|donation|transfer|scrap|auction — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: net_disposal_value
attributes.description: The net financial result of the disposal transaction, calculated as disposal proceeds minus disposal costs. May be positive (gain) or negative (loss).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, special handling instructions, lessons learned, or other relevant information about the disposal transaction.

attributes.name: proceeds
attributes.description: The monetary amount received from the disposal of the asset, if any. Represents sale price, salvage value, or auction proceeds. Zero for demolition or scrap with no recovery value.

attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: The primary business or operational reason for retiring the asset. Captures whether disposal was due to end of useful life, failure, regulatory mandate, planned replacement, or other strategic decision. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: end_of_life|catastrophic_failure|obsolescence|regulatory_requirement|replacement|consolidation|capacity_reduction|safety_hazard|environmental_compliance — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: retirement_reason_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context and details about the reason for asset retirement. May include failure analysis, condition assessment summary, or regulatory citation.

attributes.name: sap_asset_retirement_doc
attributes.description: The SAP FI-AA asset retirement document number generated when the disposal transaction was posted to the financial system. Used for financial audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: sap_posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the asset retirement transaction was posted to SAP FI-AA general ledger. May differ from disposal date due to period-end closing rules.

attributes.name: transfer_to_entity
attributes.description: Name of the entity (department, municipality, or organization) to which the asset was transferred, if disposal method was transfer. Null for other disposal methods.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: The Maximo work order number associated with the physical removal, demolition, or disposal activity. Links disposal transaction to field execution.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or name of the person who created this disposal record. Audit trail for accountability.

products.name: inspection_event
products.description: Operational record of a physical inspection performed on an asset or infrastructure component, including inspection type (routine, regulatory, post-incident, pre-commissioning), inspector identity, inspection date, checklist used, pass/fail outcome, deficiencies identified, corrective action required flag, and regulatory permit reference. Distinct from condition_assessment (which produces a scored condition grade) — inspection_event captures compliance-driven inspection activities required by EPA, state primacy agencies, and OSHA.

attributes.name: inspection_event_id

attributes.name: facility_id

attributes.name: inspection_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset or infrastructure component that was inspected.

attributes.name: inspection_checklist_id

attributes.name: inspection_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset or infrastructure component that was inspected.

attributes.name: inspector_employee_id

attributes.name: primary_inspection_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervisor or manager who reviewed and approved the inspection results.

attributes.name: water_sample_id

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent work order under which this inspection was performed, if applicable.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the inspection results were formally approved by the reviewing authority.

attributes.name: checklist_version

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag

attributes.name: critical_deficiency_flag

attributes.name: inspection_date

attributes.name: inspection_end_time

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_days

attributes.name: inspection_notes

attributes.name: inspection_start_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the inspection activity commenced.

attributes.name: inspection_status

attributes.name: inspector_certification_num
attributes.description: Professional certification or license number of the inspector, if required by regulatory authority.

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Full name of the inspector who conducted the inspection.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inspection event record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: maximo_inspection_num
attributes.description: External inspection identifier from IBM Maximo CMMS system.

It captures class-specific procurement strategies, lead times, cost benchmarks, and approved vendor counts used for materials planning, strategic sourcing decisions, and inventory optimization.
